description:
## Current scope
Prune removal merged as #4257 (9c12a8d929). Historical local results passed on current specification-sized data. Remaining work is post-merge trunk verification and honest disposition of the unreproduced AQ5 stall, not another prune removal.

## Historical finding (retained for provenance)
#4149 (25a271c1) made FactCashBalances, FactHoldings, FactMarketHistory and FactWatches scale linearly (SF1 facts went from 275k to 6.77M rows, matching benchmark_specs.yaml). In trunk UAT 43154678095, spark tpcdi 1.0 went from 311 s to the 1200 s timeout, datafusion tpcdi 1.0 from 62 s to two timeouts, clickhouse-local 1.0 from 33 s to 255 s, and spark 0.1 from 199 s to 411 s. The join-heavy analytic queries AQ2, AQ4-AQ7 and AQ10 take 11-21 s each locally on DataFusion, and one local run stalled more than 20 minutes on AQ5 in the second pass (undiagnosed, shared machine). Spark and DataFusion tpcdi 1.0 are compatibility-pruned in the release gate until this is fixed.

## Decision gates
Prune removal is already merged in #4257 (9c12a8d929); do not implement it again. Read a Trunk UAT source SHA containing that commit before asserting completion. A repeat AQ5 stall requires diagnosis, not attribution to data volume by assumption. Engine-memory work belongs to heavy-guard-watchdog-20261030-deferral-1.

## Verification rubric
Pass: retain measured 64.07 s DataFusion and 451 s Spark evidence as historical local results, and link a post-merge trunk run showing both exact SF 1 cells executed, not pruned, with all queries passing inside 1200 s. Record whether the old AQ5 stall is explained or remains unreproduced. Fail: a green workflow with skipped cells or the 3 GiB local run presented as proof of default-heap trunk success.

## Additional guardrails
Do not relax the timeout, shrink the data, or re-prune to make this item pass. The historical shared-host AQ5 stall is not proven fixed merely because a later run passed.
